page.overview:
Who is Kintaro?

Kintaro is a character from the Mortal Kombat fighting game series. A member of the Shokan race, Kintaro has been a recurring antagonist and Sub-Boss throughout his appearances in the series.

Kintaro made his debut in Mortal Kombat II as the game's Sub-Boss and made his playable debut in Mortal Kombat Trilogy.

Kintaro returned as a non-playable sub-boss in Mortal Kombat (2011) alongside Goro and Shang Tsung, although the latter was a playable character.

Kintaro replaced Goro after the latter was defeated by Liu Kang in Mortal Kombat. Unlike Goro and Sheeva, Kintaro has tiger striped markings all over his body as well as sharp fangs, claws and feline-like feet, being the only Shokan seen thus far to have such features. According to his Mortal Kombat (2011) bio, this is indicative of the lower-class Tigrar clan of Shokan, differing from the more elite-class Draco clan that Goro and Sheeva belong to, so there are likely more of his kind out there.
